Acolyte of Seiryu outfit.x: The Acolyte of Seiryu outfit is a cosmetic outfit available to purchase from the Daemonheim Rewards shop. It consists of 5 pieces, each purchased separately for a total cost of 100,000 Dungeoneering tokens.

sc: Antique chests were obtainable from Treasure Hunter during the Buried Treasure or Loot Duels promotion.
The following were previous antiques obtainable on the Buried Treasure promos that ran since 10 May 2017 to 15 January 2019, including Second Chance Tuesday.
The augmented crystal wand is a level 70 Magic main hand weapon created by using an augmentor on a crystal wand.
The augmented Sunspear (melee) is an item that can be made by attaching an augmentor to a Sunspear (melee).
Bagged chrysanthemum can be bought in the Falador Park from the Garden supplier for 10,000 coins.

tx: The bane burial platelegs require 1,890 progress to complete.

sc: The blessed pot is an item used in Desert Treasure, created by taking a silver pot (garlic) to be blessed by the High Priest on Entrana, or by using garlic powder on a blessed pot (blood).

p: Outside Hollow Hill in Havenhythe (three spawns)
sc: It is often dropped by Imps and Zombies and is also a joke reward from Eadgar's Ruse and My Arm's Big Adventure.
Burnt umber is an archaeology material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 66 Archaeology.
Burnt umber is made by heating raw umber, drying the iron oxide giving the pigment a more reddish hue.
The castle wars token enhancer is a reward enhancer that increases the gold tickets earned during Castle Wars.
When obtained, it is automatically converted into 20 charges within Wythien's enhancer management interface, where the effect can be toggled on or off.
Chaos relics (rare) are drops from monsters in The Zamorakian Undercity.
The damaged book is a book held in the pocket slot that can be obtained for 5,000 coins from Jossik after completing Horror from the Deep.

p: Inside the Witchaven dungeon (during The Slug Menace quest)
sc: It is found on the floor in the newly discovered shrine under Witchaven and is used to make sea slug glue during the quest.
After the Salt in the Wound quest, the item spawn disappears.

Death Seeker Steed.x: The Death Seeker Steed is a companion pet that can be bought on the Marketplace as part of the Death Reaper Steed Set. Its upgraded form, the Death Bringer Steed, can be unlocked by completing 10 Slayer assignments while having any Death Seeker cosmetic active.

sc: It is made by firing a decorated fishing urn (unfired) in a pottery oven, a portable crafter or using the Lunar spell Fire Urn, requiring level 76 Crafting and giving 72 Crafting experience.
The necklace can be purchased from Daemonheim Rewards for 35,000 Dungeoneering tokens, and requires level 90 Prayer and 75 Dungeoneering to purchase.

It is rarely found while traversing the Anachronia Agility Course, as a reward from Big Game Hunter, as a drop from killing slayer monsters on the island, and while hunting pawya, grenwall, ruby harvests, and black warlocks on Anachronia.
Players can obtain this item rarely while skilling in the Dream of Iaia.

Dulcin Gown.x: Dulcin Gown is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Dulcin set.

tx: The rarity of rewards varies by total skill level.
sc: After activating the aura, a magical chest spawns immediately if doing an appropriate activity (see Triggers below).
There is a minimum time of 9 minutes between chest spawns.

Elemental (Flameheart) Legs.x: Elemental (Flameheart) Legs is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Elemental (Flameheart).

sc: The emerald demon statuette is a demon statuette found on a plinth near the skoblins in the Lumbridge Catacombs after completing The Blood Pact.
The Epic of Hebe, excerpt 3 can be obtained from excavating at the acropolis debris or bibliotheke debris excavation hotspots at the Everlight Dig Site.
Foo is a pet received as a reward for handing in 12,600 zodiac talismans to Yinteng during the Zodiac Festival promotion.
It is made by using class 5 sacred clay on a creation kiln, requiring 80 Cooking.
Forinthry Royal Knight Shield is a shield cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 8 of Forinthry Frontier with the premier pass.
It is made by using two soft clay on a potter's wheel, requiring 17 Crafting and giving 20 experience.

s: Accessed via frozen or warped token
sc: The Frozen Loot Beam token is a cosmetic token reward from the Dungeon Delve: Daemonheim Treasure Hunter promotion.
During the 2025 Christmas event, it can also be obtained from Santa's Christmas Presents.

s: Accessed via frozen or warped token
sc: During the 2025 Christmas event, it can also be obtained from Santa's Christmas Presents.
The ghostly reaver garb top is part of the Ghostly reaver outfit which is made with 1500 ghostweave.

Golden boots of subjugation.x: The golden boots of subjugation are a piece of golden subjugation equipment that can be won from Leonard's Lucky Dip. They have the same bonuses and requirements as the regular boots of subjugation, but they are untradeable and have a different appearance.

sc: Golden leaping sturgeon eggs are a reward from fishing leaping sturgeon, used in the Aquarium of a player-owned house.
As a rare reward from fishing leaping sturgeon (level 70 Fishing required) -- approximately 2 hours on average to get the egg.

Golden warpriest of Armadyl gauntlets.x: The golden warpriest of Armadyl gauntlets are hybrid glove armour that that can be won from the Balthazar's Big Raffle (except the 2015 raffle).

sc: Grimy ardrigal is a herb that is obtained by searching for the palm trees located north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai in Karamja, near the coast of the Harpie Bug Swarms.
It can be cleaned to obtain clean ardrigal.
The Hefin course multiplier is a token that increases the Agility experience received for traversing obstacles on Hefin Agility Course by 20%.

Hefin course multiplier tokens can be obtained as an uncommon reward from a light creature after completing a lap on Hefin Agility Course, when pickpocketing Hefin workers or as a reward from exchanging 10 crystal motherlode shards with Wythien.
The Helm of Trials is a part of the Armour of Trials, which is obtained from May's Quest Caravan by allocating 75 quest points to the combat track.

w: Time Crash/Rewards with Smouldering Lamps! modifier
sc: Huge smouldering lamp is an item obtainable via Treasure Hunter.
The following is a table detailing the number of base experience received from a huge smouldering lamp for any given skill level.
A huge XP lamp is a reward from Spy Club.
It is also a completion reward from Desperate Times.

Hydro Body.x: Hydro Body is a torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Hydro Suit.

sc: The weapon is created by blessing an off-hand khopesh of the Kharidian with the Blessing of the Sea, the Blessing of the Sky, and the Blessing of the Sand, requiring level 92 Crafting.
The off-hand khopesh of the Kharidian can rarely be obtained from looting treasure chests in the Shifting Tombs minigame.
The Korasi memory half is an item obtained after speaking to Jessika in the afterlife during Nomad's Elegy.
The kratonite hatchet is a tier 4 hatchet, found in Daemonheim.
It can be made from one kratonite bar, requiring level 32 Smithing and giving 38 experience.
It can be bought from the Farmers' Market for 2,500 beans.

tx: Players may obtain the following rewards from these lucky charms:
sc: They are purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop for 10,000 Dungeoneering tokens each.
While the rewards listed below can be obtained without the use of a charm, they are significantly rarer.

Lunar torso (yellow).x: The lunar torso is a piece of lunar equipment worn in the torso slot. It can be recoloured into a blue, green, or red torso or back to its original colour by using it on Diango after purchasing the Lunar Equipment (re-colour) service from Solomon's General Store for 2,000 Loyalty Points or by claiming the Loyalty Point Bundle from the Marketplace.

sc: Mammoth tusks are the tusks of acheron mammoths, which the player will receive as a drop from fighting them.
It can be obtained by killing manifest shadows, pickpocketing from Amlodd workers, or as a possible reward from Light Creatures on the Hefin Agility Course.
Manifest shadow cores do not show up in area loot when dropped by manifest shadows.
The master salvation aura is a tier 3 aura that can be bought from the Solomon's General Store for 30,500 Loyalty Points.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought, so total cost for a specific tier of salvation aura is the cumulative cost in the following table.
A medium XP lamp (Cooking) is a fairly common prize from Treasure Hunter.
The memoriam crystal z12 is found on Freneskae.
Meowsketeer's gloves token is an unlock token available as a Treasure Hunter reward during the Catwalk: The Meowsketeer promotion.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 mithril bars and a mithril off hand sword, requiring 640 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.
The modified blacksmith's helmet is made by using a blacksmith's helmet on a blacksmith's helmet add-on.

Necturion Shield.x: The Necturion Shield is a shield cosmetic override that is part of the Necturion Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, it can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

sc: The novite full helm is an item that can only be obtained and used while Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
Oddments were currency obtained from Treasure Hunter.
They were also obtainable during the Beach events, Yak tracks, Christmas Advent Calendars, and as monthly reward (1,000) from Premier Club.
It may be produced using the Smithing skill or obtained as a monster drop.
Off-white partyhats were joke item partyhats dropped by JMod clones.

Omens.x: Omens is a cosmetic override set unlocked by finishing off Vorago with the maul of omens in hard mode. Pieces of the set are unlocked depending on the rotation. Only the player finishing off Vorago during phase 11 will unlock the override if not already owned.

sc: It can be found in the garden behind Jerico's house, immediately south of the northern bank in East Ardougne.

r: Completion of Land of the Goblins
sc: The plain of mud sphere is obtained during and after the Land of the Goblins quest from Oldak for 2 law runes and a piece of molten glass.
It can be made into the recipe with the other three fragments.
Pthentraken's head is a boss trophy obtained from defeating Pthentraken.
The purple corner key is a key found in Daemonheim while training the Dungeoneering skill.
Only one purple corner key can be found in a single dungeon.

Raptor (Advanced) Shield.x: Raptor (Advanced) Shield is a shield cosmetic override that can be obtained by defeating any combination of 50 Wyverns, Ripper Demons, Camel Warriors and Acheron mammoths with the Raptor outfit unlocked.

Reforged Rune Armour (Gilded).x: Reforged Rune Armour (Gilded) is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked as part of the Rune Armour (Gilded) Bundle.

sc: They can't be obtained as an item.
The sapphire golem head is part of the sapphire golem outfit that is created from 3,600 gemstone golem fragments with level 80 Mining and 20 Invention.
It was previously available from Treasure Hunter.
The shaman's moccasins is part of the shaman's outfit that can be unlocked after accumulating at least 2,400 Blessings of the Wolf at the Shrine of the Spirit Wolves.
In the original promotion, it could made by combining 100 spirit wolf blood with spirit wolf paws, which were available on the Squeal of Fortune from 16 to 26 August 2013.
It is dropped by Salarin the Twisted but is also a potential loot from catching a magpie impling, as well as a possible reward from Triskelion Treasures.

Skirmisher tassets.x: The skirmisher tassets are pair of ranging tassets from the skirmisher armour. It is a rare prize from the Treasure Hunter.

sc: The Small Construction XP lamp is a possible reward from a supply cache in the Invasion of Falador event.
Snufftruffles are a type of mushroom found while foraging mushroom clusters on the island of Goshima within the Arc region of the Wushanko Isles.

Spark chitin is a secondary Herblore ingredient obtained from Brutish dinosaurs (40 per harvest), Scimitops (50 per harvest), Asciatops (65 per harvest), and Malletops (85 per harvest) at the Ranch Out of Time.
It was made by combining a blue charm with 151 spirit shards and a Jug of water.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.

s: Daemonheim starting room and boss room
Daemonheim starting room and boss room
sc: As with all Dungeoneering hides, no tanning is required before these can be made into armour.
Players can obtain the hide either by hunting a submastyx or buying it from the Smuggler.

tx: The recipe for super melee potion can be found inside Daemonheim while training Dungeoneering, or purchased from Daemonheim Rewards after asking Lady Meilyr for details. After finding the unreadable page, purchasing the recipe for coins at the Recipe Shop will permanently unlock the ability to mix the potion. The shop is operated by Lady Meilyr or any harmony pillar farmer in the Meilyr district of Prifddinas.
sc: The super melee potion is a combination potion that can be made at level 81 Herblore after unlocking the recipe.
It is made by combining a super attack (4), super defence (4) and super strength (4) into a crystal flask, giving 281.
They are part of the Death Lotus equipment set, and can be made on a workbench in your player-owned port workshop with 20 lacquer at level 90 Crafting.
Tefnut, Disciple of Amascut is a book found in the Grand Library of Menaphos, written by Tefnut, a disciple of Amascut.
It is obtained from the second bookcase north of Kohnen the librarian near the entrance inside the library.
The book explained how to use the tightrope feature, and could be obtained by speaking to the Agility assistant.
It is created by combining the top, middle, and base pieces.
Each piece can be obtained via different activities on Anachronia.
The Twisted Jester Boots are a feet slot cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the Twisted Jester Pack.
Tyrannoleather body is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.

Upgraded bone blowpipe can be made at level 87 Fletching and Crafting by combining the bone blowpipe with blowpipe chitin, blowpipe feather, and blowpipe fins, all of which are dropped by certain dinosaur Slayer monsters on Anachronia.
The doubled poison rate only applies to poison that comes from the blowpipe's inherent poison effect and weapon poison potions, making them hit every 4.
Varrock Guard shield is a cosmetic override shield that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 18 of the Yak to Basics event.
It is obtained from Revenants killed in the Forinthry Dungeon and the Chaos Elemental.
It was obtainable by paying 41,000 Renown from the Bird and the Beast - World Event 2 at the Bandosian quartermaster, requiring a dragon Bandosian token to purchase.
Currently, it can be obtained by members as a rare drop from Bandosians in the God Wars Dungeon.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
The wilderness sword 1 is a reward from completing the easy Wilderness achievements.
It can be obtained from Mr Ex in Edgeville.
During The Eyes of Glouphrie, it may be obtained from Brimstail by talking to him.
During The Path of Glouphrie, it may be found in Gnome Village Dungeon.
The Zamorakian spear is obtained from the God Wars Dungeon as a drop from K'ril Tsutsaroth and his bodyguards.
It is dropped by a variety of zombies.
After the wishlist has been completed, it can no longer obtained as a drop.
